blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court is set to issue a show-cause order against Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson, Atty. Paolo Panelo, presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero ordered on Friday. The motion to issue the order came from Senator-Judge Erwin Tulfo who took notice of Panelo’s remarks saying some senator-judges may be showing bias against Duterte during their interjection in yesterday’s trial. According to Panelo, he thought the questions of Senator-Judges Raffy Tulfo, Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan, and Risa Hontiveros may be showing bias, noting that it is not their job to challenge the credibility of defense witnesses. “I’d like to […]...
